title: Frontend Developer
description:
**Company Description**
 At the Syngenta Group, our 56,000 people across more than 90 countries strive every day to transform agriculture through tailor\-made solutions for the benefit of farmers, society and our planet – making us the world's most local agricultural technology and innovation partner.
   

  

 Website address \- https://www.syngentagroup.com/
   

  

 LI page \- https://www.linkedin.com/company/syngentagroup/posts/?feedView\=all
   

  

**Job Description**
**ROLE PURPOSE**
 Join the Austyn team to build high\-performance, intelligent user interfaces for Syngenta's AI assistant platform. You'll craft smooth, responsive experiences that transform complex AI interactions into seamless, intuitive workflows used across the organization.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
 The Frontend Developer will be responsible for:
   

  

* Build and maintain scalable web applications using Next.js and TypeScript, with a focus on performance, bundle size, and code quality.
* Implement state management using Redux Toolkit (RTK) and Zustand.
* Consume real\-time streaming endpoints (SSE) to power live AI interactions in the UI.
* Design fluid, responsive AI\-powered interfaces \- think streaming text, audio playback, image generation UIs \- with exceptional UX.
* Build pixel\-perfect, responsive layouts with Tailwind CSS.
* Optimize bundle size, load times, rendering performance, and runtime efficiency.
* Write unit and integration tests ensuring reliability and maintainability.
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers and data scientists on feature integration.
* Participate in code reviews, architectural decisions, and technical documentation.


**Skills**
* Core Expertise: Expert\-level TypeScript and modern React (hooks, reconciliation, fiber architecture, concurrent features); advanced performance optimization (code splitting, tree shaking).
* Next.js: App Router, SSR/SSG/ISR, Server Components, Edge Runtime, Streaming, Suspense, middleware, image optimization.
* State Management: Redux Toolkit (slices, reducers, async thunks, middleware, RTK Query, cache invalidation, optimistic updates), Zustand for lightweight local state, context API for scoped state.
* Styling \& UI: Tailwind CSS, utility\-first design, responsive breakpoints, custom theme configuration, pixel\-perfect responsive layouts, browser profiling.
* AI Interface Design: Progressive rendering for streaming responses, conversational UI/UX patterns, error handling for AI failures.
* Real\-time: Consuming SSE and streaming responses; rendering progressive/chunked AI output in the browser.
* Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress for E2E, TDD practices.
* Infrastructure \& Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, build tool.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with WebSocket\-based real\-time communication.
* React Flow (node\-based editors), TanStack Table.
* Familiarity with GraphQL clients (Apollo, urql).
* WCAG 2\.1 accessibility best practices.
* Sentry/Datadog monitoring and observability.
* Animation libraries (Framer Motion).
* Shadcn/UI, Radix, or Headless UI component patterns.
* Prompt engineering knowledge.
* Visual regression testing (Percy).
* Agile/Scrum workflows.


**CRITICAL SUCCESS FACTORS \& KEY CHALLENGES**
* Achieving high performance and low "Time to Interactive" in complex AI\-driven interfaces.
* Handling asynchronous and streaming AI data flows with intuitive loading states and feedback.
* Maintaining high code quality and test coverage in a fast\-paced, innovative environment..


**Innovations**
 The employee, as part of their role and potentially through multifunctional teams, is expected to participate in the creation and design of innovative solutions. This may include contributing to inventions, designs, other work products, know\-how, copyrights, software, innovations, solutions, and other intellectual assets.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
   

  

**Experience**
* 3\+ years of professional frontend development experience building production\-grade applications.
* Proven track record of writing clean, performant, well\-tested, and maintainable code.
* Experience designing and building AI application interfaces.
* Strong portfolio or GitHub profile demonstrating expertise in TypeScript, Next.js, React, and AI interfaces.


**Additional Information**
 Note: Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status

**Who are we?**



Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

  


A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.



A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
We’re looking for a Principal Talent Advisor to support hiring across Equinix’s Technology and Product function. As part of the Integrated Talent Solutions team (Talent Acquisition), you’ll play a key role in attracting and assessing top talent, guiding leaders with insights, shaping effective hiring strategies, and leading complex searches with autonomy in a collaborative, inclusive, and forward‑thinking environment.

**Key Responsibilities\-**

**Strategic Talent Advisory \& Workforce Partnership**

* Partner closely with senior leaders to understand business priorities and translate them into clear, actionable talent strategies.
* Use talent intelligence, market insights, and structured Build–Borrow–Buy–Place frameworks to shape informed hiring approaches and guide leaders toward the best talent solutions.
* Advice on role clarity, internal mobility opportunities, alternative talent channels, and market/location considerations that impact sourcing strategy.
* Influence hiring decisions by presenting data‑backed insights, funnel trends, and recruitment analytics that deepen understanding of the talent landscape and elevate hiring quality.

**End‑to‑End Recruitment Ownership**

* Lead end‑to‑end hiring for Technology roles, ensuring a thoughtful, high‑quality process that aligns with business needs.
* Build rich and diverse talent pipelines by engaging the market proactively, uncovering new talent pools, and staying close to evolving trends.
* Apply structured evaluation to surface strong candidates, offering balanced insights and clear recommendations that help hiring teams make confident decisions.
* Collaborate with wider People team to shape positive outcomes.
* Stay ahead of potential challenges in the hiring process, removing obstacles early and keeping searches moving with clarity, speed, and quality.
* Identify efficiency opportunities to automate workflows, streamline handoffs, and enhance the overall speed and quality of the hiring process.
* Bring an AI‑first mindset to daily work. Use intelligent tools and automation to simplify workflows, accelerate sourcing, and drive smarter, more efficient hiring.

**Excellence in Candidate \& Hiring Manager Experience**

* Deliver a consistent, high‑touch experience to candidates and hiring managers.
* Coach hiring teams on assessment quality, structured interviewing, competency frameworks, and reducing interview bias.
* Reinforce Equinix’s brand and EVP through storytelling and professional representation in the talent marketplace.

**Talent Orchestration \& Ecosystem Integration**

* Activate internal talent pathways, including internal mobility, referrals. Support New‑to‑Career or Pathway programs.
* Collaborate with Talent Marketing to design targeted campaigns and strengthen brand presence in key markets.
* Contribute to regional talent programs, workforce initiatives, and hiring process improvements.
* Drive Equinix’s talent visibility by hosting meet‑ups, participating in industry events and conferences, and representing the company at talent‑attraction activities to strengthen our presence and build talent pipelines.

**Data, Insights \& Operational Discipline**

* Use data and analytics to diagnose funnel health, identify risks, and recommend actions.
* Maintain excellent ATS hygiene, documentation, and compliance with global hiring standards.
* Role‑model structured hiring, interview discipline, and equitable decision‑making across the business.
* Provide insights and reporting that support forecasting, workforce planning, and talent initiatives.

**Experience**

* 10\+ years of hands‑on Talent Acquisition experience with exposure to regional or multi‑function hiring.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with and influence senior business leaders.
* Experience using research, data, and market insights to guide talent decisions and advise stakeholders.
* Background supporting high‑growth or complex environments; tech or digital infrastructure industry experience is a plus.

**Capabilities \& Skills**

* Strong advisory presence with the ability to challenge, influence, and guide leaders through trade‑offs.
* Deep sourcing expertise and strong understanding of talent markets and competitive dynamics.
* Data‑driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into strategic recommendations.
* Operational excellence — structured hiring, compliance, and process discipline.
* Innovative, forward‑thinking, and able to adapt quickly to changing business needs.
* Highly collaborative, with strong relationship‑building skills across HR and business functions.

title: HR Executive
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Manufacturing \& Labor)

We are seeking a high\-energy **Talent Acquisition Specialist** with a "boots\-on\-the\-ground" mindset to lead our recruitment efforts for our manufacturing facility. This isn't a typical 9\-to\-5 desk job; you will be the bridge between the local labor market and our production floor.

Your primary mission is to ensure our production lines are fully staffed with reliable, skilled, and general labor personnel to meet our demanding output schedules.

Key Responsibilities

* **High\-Volume Sourcing:** Execute aggressive sourcing strategies to attract general laborers, machine operators, warehouse staff, and skilled trades (welders, mechanics, etc.).
* **Pipeline Management:** Maintain a "ready\-to\-work" roster of candidates to minimize downtime caused by turnover or seasonal spikes.
* **Community Networking:** Build relationships with local vocational schools, unemployment offices, and community centers to create a steady stream of local talent.
* **Screening \& Onboarding:** Conduct rapid\-fire phone screens and in\-person interviews. Manage the full onboarding process, including background checks, drug screenings, and safety orientations.
* **Agency Management:** Partner with and oversee external staffing agencies when necessary to fill short\-term labor gaps.
* **Retention Analysis:** Work closely with Floor Managers to understand "why" people stay or leave, providing feedback to leadership to improve workplace culture.

Qualifications \& Skills

* **Experience:** 2\+ years in high\-volume recruitment, ideally within manufacturing, logistics, or construction.
* **The "Hustle":** Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment where priorities shift based on production needs.
* **Communication:** Strong interpersonal skills—you should be as comfortable talking to a CEO as you are talking to a forklift operator.
* **Adaptability:** Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and social media sourcing, but also comfortable with traditional "help wanted" outreach.
* **Knowledge:** Basic understanding of local labor laws, wage standards, and safety requirements.

Why This Role Matters

In manufacturing, the product is only as good as the people making it. You are the gatekeeper of our productivity. Without your ability to find and retain the right labor force, the machines don't run.

Note: This role may require occasional early morning or late evening hours to sync with different shift schedules on the production floor.

description:
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  





 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters — to you, to your community, and to the world.
   

  





 Progress starts with you.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 The Business Conduct Office (BCO) is an integral part of Visa's global legal, ethics and compliance team. BCO provides global oversight for the Visa Code of Business Conduct \& Ethics (the "Code"), Visa's Compliance Hotline and online compliance reporting system, conducts investigations, provides general compliance counsel to various areas of the Visa business, and provides oversight for related policies (such as Conflicts of Interest and Non\-Retaliation).
   

  





 The Analyst will support Visa’s BCO forensics and investigations program, managing key aspects of forensics and eDiscovery workflows including data scoping, acquisition, analysis, and reporting. The role will work closely with BCO investigators, Legal, Cybersecurity, IT, and Employee Relations to provide forensic support on internal investigations globally, while assisting with case management, matter tracking, data analytics, operational reporting, and related special projects.
   

  





 Visa promotes an ethical culture and provides employees and outside partners with safe and confidential channels to report concerns. This position requires proactive day\-to\-day management of the Business Conduct office.
   

  





 This position is an Individual Contributor role.
   

  




* Manage forensic and eDiscovery workflows in close partnership with compliance investigators, Legal, Cybersecurity, IT, and Employee Relations (ER), including data scoping, subject identification, and preparation for forensic review.
* Manage forensic data acquisition and preservation across different data sources, endpoints, mobile devices, and Internet\-based sources.
* Conduct forensic analysis, develop investigative timelines and reports, and present findings to lead investigators. Experience with OSINT tools, Nuix, Magnet Axiom, EnCase, FTK, and Cellebrite is a plus.
* Assist and manage BCO investigations, particularly matters involving key controls and cybersecurity policy violations. Participate in interviews, case management, and oversee matter tracking and documentation.
* Maintain operational dashboards for reporting and support strategic initiatives as required. Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau or similar data visualization tools is a plus.
* Manage forensic tools and platforms, performing regular assessments, updates, and troubleshooting to ensure readiness.
* Manage data exports from cloud platforms and endpoints. Proficiency with Microsoft eDiscovery platform is a plus.
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, and Go for automation and security systems integration is a plus.
* Experience with data analytics and Generative AI in legal and compliance, cybersecurity or related functions is a plus.



 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* 5 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) in computer science, digital forensics, cybersecurity or other relevant field of study
* Professional certifications, i.e. EnCase Certified Examiner (EnCE), GIAC (GCFE, GCFA, GOSI, GASF), Certified Information Systems Security professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) or other similar credentials is a plus
* Experience managing the forensic and eDiscovery lifecycle from intake, data ingestion, analysis, and summary reports
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent critical and data analytic skills
* Proactive, highly responsive, sensitive to confidentiality concerns, ability to empathize while maintaining professional objectivity, collaborative in close team environment, diplomatic, and flexible in adapting to occasional changes in case priorities
* Ability to work independently and use good judgment while also collaborating frequently with BCO team members and others in Legal/Compliance/People Team

 Visa is an EEO Employer. title: Sr. HR & Admin Executive
description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities – HR \& Administration**

**1\. Human Resource Management**

**Recruitment \& Manpower Planning**

* Identify manpower requirements in consultation with department heads.
* Prepare job descriptions and role specifications for new positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, consultants, social media, and internal references.
* Conduct preliminary screening and coordinate interviews with department managers.
* Manage the entire recruitment cycle including offer letter issuance and joining formalities.
* Maintain a database of potential candidates for future requirements.

**Employee Onboarding \& Induction**

* Conduct joining formalities and documentation for new employees.
* Coordinate induction programs to familiarize employees with company policies, culture, and safety practices.
* Maintain employee personal files and records.

**2\. Performance Management**

**KPI / KRA Setting**

* Coordinate with management and department heads to define **KPIs / KRAs** for employees.
* Ensure KPIs are measurable, achievable, and aligned with company goals.
* Monitor performance periodically and assist in evaluation processes.
* Support annual or quarterly performance appraisal cycles.
* Maintain documentation of performance reviews and improvement plans.

**3\. Payroll \& Statutory Compliance**

**Payroll Management**

* Maintain attendance records and leave management.
* Prepare monthly payroll including salary calculations, overtime, deductions, and reimbursements.
* Ensure timely salary disbursement.
* Maintain payroll records and salary registers.

**Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and regulations.
* Manage statutory contributions such as **PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and TDS**.
* Coordinate with auditors and consultants for statutory filings.
* Maintain compliance records and registers.

**4\. Employee Welfare \& Engagement**

* Implement employee welfare programs to promote a positive work environment.
* Address employee grievances and workplace concerns.
* Ensure proper facilities such as drinking water, rest areas, and safety measures.
* Organize employee engagement activities, celebrations, and recognition programs.
* Support training and skill development initiatives.

**5\. Administration \& Office Management**

**General Administration**

* Manage day\-to\-day office administration activities.
* Maintain office infrastructure, equipment, and utilities.
* Coordinate with vendors for office supplies, maintenance, and services.
* Ensure workplace cleanliness, safety, and discipline.

**Facility Management**

* Supervise security, housekeeping, and maintenance staff.
* Ensure proper upkeep of office premises, factory areas, and common facilities.
* Coordinate repairs and maintenance activities.

**6\. Housekeeping \& Facility Hygiene**

* Monitor housekeeping staff and maintain cleanliness across office and production areas.
* Ensure waste disposal and hygiene standards are followed.
* Maintain stock of cleaning materials and supplies.
* Conduct regular inspections to maintain workplace hygiene.

**7\. Documentation \& Records**

* Maintain employee records, contracts, and HR documentation.
* Issue HR\-related letters such as appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, and relieving letters.
* Maintain attendance, leave records, and employee database.

**8\. Policy Implementation**

* Ensure employees follow company policies and procedures.
* Assist management in implementing new HR policies and administrative systems.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

title: Workplace Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description** – Manager (CL\-7\)

**Job Title**: Workplace Service Delivery Manager (CL\-7\)

**Management Level**: CL – 7

**Work Location**: Mumbai

**Must have Skills**: Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration

**Good to have Skills**: Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PMP Certification

**Department**: Corporate Function

**Job Summary**


Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**Integrated Facility management**

* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly/ quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.

**Engineering and Technical Services**

* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety. Leverage tools to improve quality of services, including office meters, sensors and SLA tracking.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

**Statutory Compliance and Risks**

* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.

**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**

* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads , CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.

**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**

* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.

**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**

* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.

**Cafeteria Management**

* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor .
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.

**Team Management**

* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**

* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.

**Projects and Transitions**

* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.

**Professional \& Technical Skills**

* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word), working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.

**Additional Information:**

* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of Mumbai offices.

  

**Experience**: Minimum 10 years of military experience with at least 4 \- 5 years of corporate IFM experience for Veterans/ Min 15 years of experience in Facility management and administration for others.

**Educational Qualification**: Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full\-time MBA or both would be an added advantage.

title: Software Tester Intern
description:
**Educational Background:**

* **Bachelor's Degree:** A degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field provides a strong foundation in software development principles and testing methodologies.
* **Other Disciplines:** Graduates from fields like mathematics, physics, chemistry, or electrical engineering can also transition into software testing with relevant skills and experience.
* **Coding Bootcamps:** These intensive programs can provide a focused curriculum in software testing and related technologies, often leading to job placement assistance.
* **Diploma or Postgraduate Certificate:** A diploma or postgraduate certificate in software testing, IT, or engineering can also be a valuable asset.

**Technical Skills:**

* **Programming Languages:** Familiarity with languages like Java, Python, or JavaScript is essential for automation testing.
* **Testing Tools:** Knowledge and experience with tools like Selenium, Appium, TestNG, Git, and Jenkins are crucial for various testing tasks.
* **Database Knowledge:** Understanding databases and the ability to write SQL queries is important for backend testing.
* **Scripting:** Proficiency in scripting languages for automating test cases is highly desirable.
* **Agile Methodologies:** Understanding Agile development practices is important as it's a common framework for software development.
* **CI/CD:** Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines is beneficial.

**Soft Skills:**

* **Communication Skills:** Clear and concise communication is essential for reporting bugs, collaborating with developers, and documenting test results.
* **Analytical Thinking:** The ability to analyze complex problems, identify potential issues, and devise effective testing strategies is crucial.
* **Attention to Detail:** Software testing requires meticulousness and an eye for detail to catch even minor defects.
* **Problem\-Solving Skills:** Testers need to be able to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and propose solutions.
* **Critical Thinking:** The ability to think critically and question assumptions is vital for effective testing.

**Experience:**

* Freshers only

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From ₹6,000\.00 per month

title: QA Tester Trainee
description:
**Location:** Bhopal  
**Experience:** 2–4 Months

About the Role

We are looking for a **detail\-oriented QA Tester Trainee** who is passionate about software quality and testing. The candidate will assist in testing web and mobile applications, identifying bugs, and ensuring that products meet quality standards before release.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand project requirements, user stories, and application workflows.
* Identify test scenarios and prepare detailed **test cases** for various functionalities.
* Perform **functional testing** to ensure the application works as expected.
* Conduct **Smoke Testing and Sanity Testing** to validate critical functionalities.
* Execute test cases and document results accurately.
* Identify, report, and track bugs using proper documentation.
* Collaborate with developers and team members to resolve issues.
* Perform **regression testing** after bug fixes to ensure existing functionality is not affected.
* Assist in testing **web applications and mobile applications (Android/iOS)** across different devices and browsers.
* Help prepare **test data and testing environments** for applications.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of **Software Testing concepts**.
* Knowledge of **Test Cases, Regression Testing, Smoke Testing, and Sanity Testing**.
* Understanding of **web and mobile application testing approaches**.
* Ability to analyze application requirements and identify test scenarios.
* Strong **analytical and problem\-solving skills**.
* **Good communication skills** (written and verbal).
* Basic understanding of **software development lifecycle (SDLC) and testing lifecycle (STLC)** is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

* 2–4 months of internship or training experience in **Software Testing / QA**.
* Familiarity with **manual testing methodologies**.
* Basic knowledge of **bug tracking tools or testing tools** is an advantage.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on **real\-time projects**.
* Learning and mentorship from experienced QA professionals.
* Exposure to **web and mobile application testing environments**.
* Career growth opportunities in **Software Quality Assurance**.

Job Types: Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹7,500\.00 \- ₹8,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many months of experience do you have in QA Testing?
* Are you comfortable for 6 months training with PPO?
* Are you comfortable for Bhopal Location?

title: PROJECT MANAGER L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
   

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
   

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
 



 \- Client Relationship Management
   

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients
   

 \- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
 



 \- Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
 



 \- Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
   

 \- Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
   

 \- Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
   

 \- Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
 


 ͏
 
 \- Operational Excellence
   

 \- Automation Focus
   

 \- Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
   

 \- Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
 



  

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
 



 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
 



 \- Fresher engagement program
   

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
 



 \- Team Management
   

 \- Resourcing
   

 \- Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
   

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team
 



 \- Talent Management
   

 \- Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
   

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
   

  
 


 ͏

 PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
   

  
   

 2\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ operational efficiency
   

  
   

 Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects

description:
**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) / KPIs**

**1\. Sales \& Commercial Growth**

* Drive pharmacy sales by ensuring **100% fulfillment** of all internal prescriptions from clinic doctors.
* Educate patients on the critical importance of specialty supplements (e.g., Ultra Q300, Alafin) to improve their therapy outcomes.
* Manage discount structures while strictly maintaining target profit margins.
* Identify and document the number of patients who consulted but did not purchase medicines, including the specific reasons for non\-purchase.

**2\. Inventory \& Vendor Management**

* Negotiate purchase margins and credit periods with pharmaceutical distributors.
* Source and onboard new vendors specifically for specialized diabetic care products such as CGM sensors, insulin pumps, and orthopedic supports.
* Conduct weekly physical stock verification (Actual vs. System Stock) and manage "Returns to Vendor" (RTV) for near\-expiry or damaged goods.
* Perform monthly "Near\-Expiry" audits with a **6\-month window** to liquidate stock before it becomes a loss.

**3\. Clinical \& Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain strict, documented temperature logs for insulin and other biologicals.
* Ensure 100% adherence to statutory requirements, including **Drug License, Schedule H/H1 registers, and Narcotics records**.
* Oversee and document the movement of medicines from the pharmacy to ISR therapy rooms and ensure all unused returns are collected immediately.
* Audit billing accuracy daily to prevent any unauthorized dispensing or financial leakage.

**4\. Daily Clinic Closure \& Reporting**

* Ensure all cash, credit, and digital payments are reconciled against the daily sales summary.
* Conduct a "Random 10\-Item" physical count every evening to verify system accuracy.
* Submit the mandatory **Daily Pharmacy Report (DPR)** by **8:00 PM** sharp, covering sales, stock\-out alerts, and leakage analysis.
